about: Logos of the companies Taimoor Alam worked for or with, for taimooralam.com and for job-search documents. Served at https://taimooralam.com/logos/<file>. Each company has <slug>.svg for light backgrounds and <slug>-on-dark.svg for dark ones. Built 2026-10-14 (portfolio#7). 'source' says where the logo came from; 'how' says whether the file is the original, a recolour of it, or a vector trace of a raster original.

logos.note: His own company. Added at his request, 2026-10-14.
logos.how: light: original. on-dark: the dark-brown name recoloured to the brand's cream #F5EFE7, as in lockup-on-dark.svg but without its background.
original; the red reads on both grounds, so both files are the same.

logos.note: He named the Samdock logo for DAYPAIO, 2026-10-14. samdock.com is today run by Samdock.ONE GmbH; this is the logo it has used since 2022.
logos.source: https://samdock.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Samdock_logo.png, via web.archive.org snapshot 20220523024743 (796x103 PNG, white wordmark)
logos.how: vector trace of the PNG; the D's gradient sampled from it (#ff73c2 to #faa774). on-dark: original white wordmark. light: wordmark recoloured #1a1a1a.
